item.title: Arlington County Sues Over Trump's Triumphal Arch
item.description: The Arlington County Board in Virginia filed a lawsuit Thursday opposing construction of the Triumphal Arch, becoming the first governmental body to do so.

item.title: Rep. Perry Tells Newsmax Democrats Spending Millions to Defeat Him
item.description: Rep. Scott Perry, R-Pa., told Newsmax on Thursday he is confident he can win reelection despite a wave of negative advertising and an expected challenge.

item.title: The Essex Files: Far-Left Purity Tests Divide NYC
Sec. Mullin Tells Newsmax Vance 'Spot On' on Microsoft PERM
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin told Newsmax on Thursday that Vice President JD Vance was "100%" correct to suspend Microsoft from the federal program.
